rules.authoritative_inputs: Quest identity, character identity, canonical item identity, cleanup key, lifecycle reason, and target quantity must be supplied explicitly.
rules.target_reconciliation: Remove only matching quest-owned quantity above the explicit target and preserve quantities at or below target.
rules.identity: Retain earlier stable instance identities; partial reductions preserve their instance identity.
rules.protection: Explicit quest_cleanup_protected state rejects cleanup atomically.
rules.rollback: Any protected item, invalid identity, or container-integrity failure restores the full pre-cleanup state.
rules.fail_closed: Do not infer cleanup triggers, quantities, party credit, or native text.
